existing_mapping.evidence: The model includes a class named 'GefenSystem' which handles operations related to external system reports, indirectly managing business operations.
The 'Salesperson' class has operations for placing orders and generating reports, indicating their responsibility in placing customer orders.
Order class attributes match with details such as order number, date, status, and shipment date, aligning with guideline specifications.
No representation of an external delivery management company like 'GalGalim' is present, indicating this is outside the system's scope.
RegularOrder associates with multiple Persons and PersonID is tracked in WineOrderDetail, indicating joint orders with multiple customers.
Customer class derived from Person includes fName, lName, phoneNumber, email; addresses are linked via Address class.
Employees, through inheritance, can be customers too by ordering wines under same conditions as specified.
UrgentOrder is a subclass and specifies associations ensuring it's created by a single customer.
UrgentOrder includes PriorityLevel and expectedDeliveryTime attributes indicating order priority requirements.
RegularOrder can involve multiple customers for single orders, shown by its association with multiple Person entities.
WineOrderDetail tracks specific wines and quantities per customer. RegularOrder has mainCustomerID attribute.
Person capturing customer info maps with fields in Person and associated classes.
Employee class has view-only method for wine info indicative of restricted access mentioned in guidelines.
Salesperson class has a method indicating access to wine recommendations, suggesting browsing capability.
WineType class with name and serial number attributes aligns with guideline of type identification.
WineType linked with Food via pairing, and Recipe class aligns with guided descriptions of food pairings.
Occasion linked with Season and Location enum types; attributes fit the guideline's context for occasion recommendations.
GefenSystem's associations with InventoryEmployee imply interactions with external systems for data updates.
Manufacturer class has fields for name, phone, email, and Address, indicating detailed manufacturer information storage.
Wine class attributes like name, description, production year, price, sweetnessLevel, and productImage match requirements.
Wine uses manufacturerID and catalogNumber, fulfilling criteria for distinguishing wines.
Wine linking to WineType by association indicates marketing staff's role in linking types.
StorageLocation class has locationNumber and name, used for storing wine, aligning with storage specs.
StorageWine is related to Wine and StorageLocation, tracking bottles, demonstrating inventory tracking.
InventoryEmployee has method updateInventory indicating capability for post-sale updates.
Salesperson class has operations for generating reports like unproductive employees and wine recommendations, covering reports context.
